name: Paths Seldom Trodden
game_text:
<keyword>Search</keyword>. To play, spot a Nazgûl. Plays to your support area.
<phase>Shadow</phase>: Remove <twilight>3</twilight> to replace the fellowship’s site with your version of the same site.
flavor_text: “‘You will have to leave the open road after tonight; for the horsemen will watch it night and day.’”
